test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

It has been / noticed that / across all his faults, / he is admired.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. across all his faults, .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"across all his faults"** is incorrect. The correct phrase should be **"despite all his faults"** or **"in spite of all his faults"**.
 
• Both **"despite"** and **"in spite of"** are used to show contrast and are followed by a noun or pronoun.
 
• Correcting this phrase will make the sentence grammatically correct and meaningful.

Correct sentence: *It has been noticed that despite all his faults, he is admired.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common phrases to show contrast:**
 
 
• **Despite:** Used before a noun or pronoun. Example: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
 
• **In spite of:** Used before a noun or pronoun. Example: In spite of his injury, he completed the race.
 
 
 
• **Other similar phrases:**
 
 
• **Even though:** Used before a clause. Example: Even though he was tired, he continued working.
 
• **Although:** Used before a clause. Example: Although it was late, they stayed up talking.
